messages:
Maya: ZetaLogix just confirmed H100 availability but shifted ETA to 6-8w. They proposed consolidating 12 units into one container to save ~18% on sea freight, and suggested FRA depot for DOA exchanges. Need input on split vs consolidation and RMA flow.

Frank: consolidation is cheaper but raises risk — one customs hit blocks entire batch. can we ask for a 6/6 split into two containers? smaller risk profile.

Olivia: for the EU rollout we need 4 GPUs in AMS within 2w. if we do 6/6, can vendor air-uplift 4 from priority pallet? air cost ok if schedule guarantees.

Zeta-bot: Quote: https://zeta.example/quotes/ZX-17183 (pdf). sea consolidation discount -18% freight. air expedite +$1,200/unit. FRA depot SLA: exchanges 48-72h (requires PO + RMA auth). Pre-shipment serials provided at booking.

Julien: If we split 6/6, we can designate one container as "priority" for potential air uplift. dims for 6-unit pallet: 120x80x120cm, ~550kg. need HS code + thermal buffer handling note for clearance.

Maya: frank/julien ok with 6/6 split if vendor supplies separate manifests + pre-shipment photos/CSV of serials. Olivia - confirm we can accept 4 units by air into AMS and pin them to eu-edge-dedicated.

Olivia: yes, we can accept 4 via air uplift to AMS. vendor must upload serial CSV >=48h before departure so we can pre-register nodes and tags. also need VIN-style labels for automated intake.

VendorAcct: we can split 6/6 and provide two AWBs + separate commercial invoices. pre-shipment photos and serial csv are standard. FRA depot: will do exchanges 48-72h but customer must supply RMA auth and PO. temporary loaners available (up to 2) for a fee.

Frank: note — reserve 2 units as internal holdback for DOA to avoid paying loaner fees. if vendor refuses holdback, we'll budget loaner fees into this PO. Also confirm warranty T&Cs around refurbished swap replacements.

Maya: action: I will lock 8 units now (priority pallet = 6 with 4 earmarked for AMS air uplift; remainder sea). defer other 4 to later wave. vendor to provide pre-ship serial CSV, CO, commercial invoice with HS code + thermal handling note. tagging @legal for import doc check.

Julien: will publish air vs sea transit matrix + expected windows by EOD and open a customs pre-clear checklist.

Olivia: FYI if air uplift fails, we'll fallback to routing capacity from us-east for canary. need console routing fallback config in place before cutover.

Maya: thanks. Zeta-bot please post booking AWBs when available. :thumbsup:

Zeta-bot: Booking created. AWB_PRIORITY=ZX1234567890, AWB_SEA=ZX0987654321. Pre-shipment serials: https://zeta.example/prepacks/ZX-17183/serials.csv

Frank: received serials. starting intake checklist: photos, manifest, thermograph, serial reconciliation. will flag mismatches here.

Maya: procurement budget note: consolidation discount applied to sea portion; air uplift estimate +$4.8k for AMS priority. I'll update the PO sheet and post final numbers.
